scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FRONT,BACK "bun run react:dev" "bun run hono:dev"
scripts.build:server: bun run react:build && bun run hono:build && bun scripts/build.ts
scripts.react:build: cd apps/react && bun run build --mode production
scripts.hono:dev: cd apps/hono && APP_ENV=development bun run dev
scripts.hono:migrate: cd apps/hono && bun x drizzle-kit migrate
scripts.fast:dev: cd apps/fast && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 2603
scripts.fast:build: cd apps/fast && uv run python -m nuitka --onefile --standalone app/main.py
scripts.build:wpf: cd apps/wpf && dotnet publish -c Release --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true
scripts.deploy:server: bun run build:server && bun run deploy
